entities.name: Provisional Capital Memorial Hall
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Provisional Capital Memorial Hall is a museum in Bumin-dong, Seo District, Busan, South Korea. The building was used by the President of South Korea, Syngman Rhee, when Busan was the provisional capital of South Korea during the Korean War.
